name: What is custom window installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom window installation involves selecting and fitting windows specifically designed to meet unique architectural requirements, aesthetic preferences, and performance needs of a home. Unlike standard sizes, custom windows can be tailored in terms of material, shape, size, and glass type to perfectly match an existing opening or a new design vision. A key decision factor is balancing design aesthetics with functional performance, such as energy efficiency or noise reduction, which can significantly influence material and glass choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom window installation involves designing and fitting windows to specific architectural, aesthetic, and performance needs of a home, rather than using standard sizes.
